name: studio2ga4gh
description: Convert Pedigree Studio sessions to the GA4GH Pedigree standard and Phenopackets.

name: ga4gh2studio
description: Convert GA4GH Pedigree and Phenopackets files into Pedigree Studio sessions.

name: studio2ped
description: Convert Pedigree Studio sessions to PED and MPED (multi-phenotype PED) files.

name: ped2studio
description: Convert PED and MPED files into Pedigree Studio sessions.

name: mpedtools
description: Read, check, merge, split, convert and query PED and MPED files.

name: hponorm
description: Check the phenotype terms in phenopackets and match them to the Human Phenotype Ontology (HPO).

name: mondonorm
description: Check the disease terms in phenopackets and match them to the MONDO disease ontology.

name: R workbench
description: R practicals in the browser: an R console, an RStudio-style editor, notebooks, R Markdown, Quarto and Shiny, next to the practical’s instructions.

name: How aligners work
description: An interactive tutorial on the algorithms inside sequence aligners, from hash tables to the Burrows–Wheeler transform, one step at a time.

name: Bioinformatics algorithms in Python
description: A three-hour practical in which students write Python in the browser and use it to look inside alignment, BLAST, trees and networks.

name: SLURM emulator
description: Practise writing, submitting and managing SLURM jobs on your own computer before using a real cluster.

name: Native Workbench
description: A Windows desktop application that runs bioinformatics tools locally and records how each result was produced. In development.

name: Genomics WebAssembly tools
description: Bioinformatics programs compiled to run in a web browser, each tested against the original program. Several of the Bioinformatics workbench’s programs come from here.

name: Analysis code for our papers
description: Lab-wide analysis scripts and shared code.
